description: This file provides utility functions for command operations within a testing or build environment, including managing work directories, moving coverage files, and ensuring context attributes.

methods.name: workdir_save_coverage_files
methods.description: Moves coverage files matching '.coverage.*' from a specified work directory to a destination directory, unless they are already in the destination.

methods.name: ensure_context_attribute_exists
methods.description: Ensures a specified attribute exists in the context object, setting it to a default value if not present.

methods.name: ensure_workdir_exists
methods.description: Ensures the work directory exists and is stored as an attribute in the context object.

methods.name: ensure_workdir_not_exists
methods.description: Removes the work directory if it exists, handling platform-specific considerations and cleanup.
